errors.text_span: Има два запълнени стълбовидни графика, представени на графиката.
errors.evidence: The chart is a combination of a filled area chart (for B2C market value) and a line chart (for growth), not two filled bar graphs.

errors.text_span: Оста Y е обозначена с приходи в трилиони долари
errors.evidence: The Y-axis has no label. The unit 'трилиони долари' is part of the legend description for the blue series, not an axis label.
The first data point for the orange line (growth) is 28% in 2018. There is no data point for 2017.

errors.text_span: Той също се увеличава по оста X
errors.evidence: The orange line representing growth does not increase. The values fluctuate and show a general downward trend: 28%, 26%, 17%, 18%, 13%, 16%.

errors.text_span: Виждат се стъпки на намаляване в процента на растеж: от 26% до 17% през 2018, от 17% до 18% през 2019, от 18% до 13% през 2022 година.
errors.evidence: This sentence is entirely incorrect. For 2018, the value is 28%. For 2019, it is 26%. The phrase 'от 17% до 18% през 2019' is nonsensical and contradicts the initial claim of 'намаляване' (decrease).
This is a sentence fragment and is redundant as the value was mentioned in the preceding (though incorrect) sentence.

The description of the orange line ('Ръст') is incomplete and inaccurate. It fails to correctly list all the data points shown in the figure (28% for 2018, 26% for 2019, 17% for 2020, 18% for 2021, 13% for 2022, and 16% for 2023).
